tools.name: system_text_generation
tools.description: Generate text with the platform-configured language model helper.

functions.short_description: Generate text with the platform text model.
functions.when_to_use: Use when the canonical contract requires text_generation.
functions.signature: generate_text_with_llm(prompt: str, *, system: str = '', temperature: float = 0.7) -> str

output_schema.description: Raw helper return value. generate_text_with_llm returns a Python str; script stdout may wrap this string as {"text": text}.

functions.return_contract: Helper returns str. The raw return value of generate_text_with_llm is a Python str; only the script stdout should wrap it in JSON such as {"text": text}.
common_mistakes: Do not call .get('text') on generate_text_with_llm result; helper returns str.
Do not subscript result['text']; wrap the str into stdout JSON yourself.

snippets.title: Generate text and wrap stdout JSON
snippets.description: Use the platform text helper; helper returns str, script stdout wraps JSON.
snippets.code:
from backend.services.skill_runtime import generate_text_with_llm

prompt = str(payload.get('prompt') or payload.get('user_request') or '')
text = generate_text_with_llm(prompt=prompt)
return {'text': text}
snippets.return_rule: generate_text_with_llm returns str; return/print a JSON object that contains that str.

tools.name: system_image_generation
tools.description: Generate an image artifact with the platform-configured image helper.

functions.short_description: Generate an image artifact with the platform image model.
functions.when_to_use: Use when the canonical contract requires image_generation.
functions.signature: generate_stable_diffusion_image(topic: str, *, filename_prefix: str = 'generated', output_dir: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]
functions.return_contract: Returns a dict with image_path, file_outputs, prompt, and source. Preserve file_outputs in script stdout.
common_mistakes: Do not drop file_outputs from stdout.
Do not treat the helper return as a string path only.

snippets.title: Generate image with file_outputs
snippets.description: Use platform image helper and preserve artifact fields.
snippets.code:
from backend.services.skill_runtime import generate_stable_diffusion_image

topic = str(payload.get('topic') or payload.get('prompt') or payload.get('user_request') or '')
result = generate_stable_diffusion_image(topic=topic, filename_prefix=payload.get('filename_prefix') or 'generated')
return {
    'image_path': result['image_path'],
    'file_outputs': result.get('file_outputs') or [result['image_path']],
    'prompt': result.get('prompt') or topic,
    'source': result.get('source') or 'stable_diffusion',
}
snippets.return_rule: Return image_path, file_outputs, prompt, and source from the helper result.
anti_patterns: Do not write image files manually when helper is available.
